title: 12 Best Cape Town's Natural Wine Scene
description: Explore Cape Town's thriving natural wine scene! Discover the best bars, restaurants, and shops offering organic, biodynamic, and minimal intervention wines. Your guide to sustainable sips.

places.name: Publik Wine Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their rotating By The Glass specials, paired with their curated cheese and charcuterie platter.

places.name: Openwine
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A flight of natural wines to discover new favorites, accompanied by their Burrata or a selection of olives.

places.name: Culture Wine Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the sommelier for a recommendation from their 'Cult Wines' natural selection, paired with their Karoo Lamb Ribs.

places.name: Leo's Wine Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Winemaker's Choice' glass for an off-menu natural wine gem, complemented by the House Focaccia with whipped feta.

places.name: The Fynbos Deli & Natural Wine Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of Swartland Grenache with their 'Fynbos Board' featuring local charcuterie and cheeses.

places.name: Rifle Range Road
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the friendly staff for their 'Producer of the Week' recommendation and enjoy a glass while browsing their extensive collection.

places.name: Grub & Vine (The Blue Room)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Opt for the tasting menu with the wine pairing, which often includes interesting natural wine selections to enhance the culinary journey.

places.name: The Shortmarket Club
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Consult with their sommelier to pair a natural wine with one of their signature dishes, like the Beef Tataki.

places.name: Black Sheep Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their daily specials are always excellent; ask the server for a natural wine pairing from their handwritten blackboard list.

places.name: Frankie Fenner Meat Merchants (Foreshore)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pick up a bottle of a local natural Chenin Blanc to enjoy with some of their cured meats or a ready-to-grill steak.

places.name: The Athletic Club & Social
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of their featured natural sparkling wine, paired with their Crispy Calamari.

places.name: Clarke's Bar & Dining Room
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their famous Classic Burger with a glass of a refreshing natural Cinsault from their evening wine list.
